mechanism: Both drugs are metabolized by CYP3A4 and CYP2D6; terbinafine is a potent CYP2D6 inhibitor that may increase dutasteride levels, and dutasteride may prolong terbinafine clearance.
action: Monitor for increased dutasteride adverse effects (gynecomastia, sexual dysfunction); consider baseline and follow-up PSA monitoring; no dose adjustment typically required but clinical vigilance is warranted.
